title: High-dimensional representation spectra fix a solid's elastic response

statements.text: Through the topological invariants of a 15-dimensional representation space of the hyperoctahedral group $H_9$, the macroscopic elastic response of a solid, tested on a 440 Hz tuning fork, is predetermined by the geometry of the vacuum condensate and Earth's gravity. A single generating function encodes the representation's whole spectral decomposition.

sources.quote: the macroscopic elastic response of a physical medium (evaluated on a reference 440 Hz tuning fork) is uniquely predetermined by the geometry of the vacuum condensate and the Earth's gravitational field
